status: DESIGNED, NOT EXECUTED. Precondition (MVP-B1 predictive accuracy on T1) NOT met for either bank (D-034); execute only if a separately registered forecasting test passes first.
question: Are public monthly bank-only disclosures already incorporated into BBCA/BBRI prices, and is any residual information tradable after costs?

events.BBRI: monthly report IR posting dates 2018+ (S-062); if a report is posted after 16:00 WIB or time unknown, event day = next trading day
events.BBCA: monthly report filename-date prefixes 2020+ (S-063); pre-2020 dates excluded (unverified)
events.quarterly: consolidated quarterly results (IDX timestamps 2024+, IR dates otherwise) as the resolution events

surprise_measures.S1_monthly: (BO YTD growth y/y at the reported month) minus (trailing 12-month BO growth known before the event); sign and standardised magnitude
surprise_measures.S2_quarter_nowcast_gap: information-matched nowcast (best pre-registered IM rule) minus consensus-implied quarter (requires consensus history; prospective only from 2026-11-24 snapshots)

returns: daily total returns (Yahoo adjusted; S-002), abnormal = stock minus EW large-bank index ex-self (BBCA, BBRI, BMRI, BBNI) and minus IHSG
analyst_revisions: change in consensus FY EPS over [event, event+10 trading days] from the append-only consensus log (forward only; no history exists)
costs: round trip 0.40% for BBCA/BBRI (0.15% buy + 0.25% sell incl. 0.10% sales tax; EST large-cap) plus 0.05% slippage; returns reported gross and net
inference: per bank, no pooling; Newey-West HAC or moving-block bootstrap (block 3 events); Holm across the 4 windows; minimum 40 events per bank
pass_rule: mean net CAR[+2,+10] in the direction of S1 > 0 with Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05 for a bank; otherwise disclosures are deemed priced in
non_goals: no trading system, no position sizing, no valuation model; accuracy is not alpha
